sourceState: Uncommitted working-window changes on this commit: default 30 ordinary working rows with per-chat compact viewport growth in 15-row increments up to 60; the 76-row hard bound and eight explicit interaction reservations remain unchanged. This is functional worktree evidence, not a clean-source cost measurement.
command: env -u RISU_TRANSCRIPT_COSTS -u RISU_TRANSCRIPT_CPU_PROFILE -u RISU_TRANSCRIPT_PROFILE_CASE -u RISU_TRANSCRIPT_DIAGNOSTICS -u RISU_TRANSCRIPT_LEGACY_PAGING RISU_BROWSER_SMOKE_WORKERS=1 pnpm test -- server/fastify/browser-smoke/transcriptResidency.spec.ts
coverage: Temporary full screenshot materialization and restoration
Desktop and mobile editing, selection, copy and folded-row anchor preservation
Eight editors across logical page reset, refusal of a ninth editor, and keyboard spacer navigation
Pending jump cancellation across route hiding and reopening
Legacy paging rollback with all 180 rows mounted
Readable visible row promotion during rapid movement

compactViewport.artifactLimitation: The successful compact case used a body attachment. Playwright’s list reporter did not persist that attachment, so exact per-row observations and compact settlement timings are unavailable from this run. No missing measurements have been reconstructed. An explicit JSON file write was added afterward for the required final normal verification.
verifiedAssertions: All ten ordinary 15-row older-page loads preserve the selected visible anchor within 1 pixel.
Bookmark message 5 acquires the highlighted resident target and brings it into the viewport under the compact CSS.
Both free-scroll positions settle with all 180 logical rows available and more than 30 ordinary message rows intersecting the viewport.
At both positions ordinary row wrappers cover the viewport within 1 pixel and visible spacer coverage is at most 1 pixel.
Every visible message ID matches its source index and its body includes the corresponding Residency row marker.
Each visible wrapper has computed height 20px, rendered wrapper height 20 pixels, rendered message row height 20 pixels, and rendered body height 20 pixels.
Every visible message body has computed visibility visible and its actual source-marker text range lies within its corresponding wrapper.
The continuous observer records no ordinary mounted-row count above 76 during traversal, bookmark navigation, and compact free scrolling.
No browser page errors are reported.

acceptance: This run passes functional assertions only. Full isolated measurements must still satisfy every original performance budget. A final 12-case normal run at the accepted clean cost source is required and must retain the new explicit compact JSON artifact.
